backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a Lead type and Map-based storage with functions to create leads (with duplicate email checking), retrieve a single lead, get all leads, and count leads.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that form submission flow with duplicate/unique email handling is implemented in EarlyAccessForm.tsx and useQueries.ts with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the NextHire AI landing page application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, primary, secondary, and other design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, title "NextHire AI", root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining root layout with Header/Footer and three routes: landing page (/), admin page (/admin), and debug leads page (/debug-leads).
Section component displaying four student-focused benefits (save time, increase interviews, apply globally, perfect for internships) in a grid with icons.
Early access form with full name, email, country, and target job role fields that handles backend responses, showing success message for null result and duplicate email error for LeadError.duplicateEmail.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with six questions about AI resume builder, ATS optimization, pricing, security, export formats, and differentiation, with expand/collapse functionality.
Features section displaying three key features (AI Resume Builder, ATS Checker, Job Tracker) with icons, titles, and descriptions in a responsive grid with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying NextHire AI branding, navigation links (About, Legal, Contact), copyright notice, and a powered-by attribution to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header navigation component with logo, desktop/mobile menus, and smooth scrolling to page sections (Features, How It Works, Pricing, FAQ) with routing support.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with headline, subheadline, CTA buttons for early access signup and how-it-works navigation, plus a laptop mockup image showcasing the resume builder.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section explaining the resume creation workflow: enter information, AI optimization, and download, with numbered icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/PricingSection.t: Pricing section displaying two plans (Free and Pro) with features, pricing, and CTA buttons that scroll to the signup section.
frontend/src/components/ProblemSection.t: Problem statement section highlighting four key resume challenges students face: ATS failures, poor formatting, generic content, and lack of measurable achievements.
Solution section showcasing four NextHire AI features: ATS optimization, keyword matching, achievement-focused rewriting, and clean templates.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Testimonials section displaying three student reviews with ratings, profile images, names, roles, and quotes about their success using NextHire AI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, using React Query for caching and automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend operations: useAllLeads fetches all leads, and useCreateLead handles lead creation with cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a blue-and-white color theme for both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays all lead submissions in a table format with loading, error, and empty states, formatting timestamps from nanoseconds.
frontend/src/pages/DebugLeadsPage.tsx: Debug page that displays all leads from the collection in a simple HTML table format for testing purposes.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Main landing page component that composes multiple marketing sections including hero, form, problem, solution, benefits, testimonials, and pricing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking a known issue where email validation incorrectly shows duplicate errors for all submissions, with a pending fix request to correct the createLead duplicate detection logic.
